name: 常规·斧·T1·衣服
prompt:
EXACT PRIMARY FAMILY/STAGE SHAPE: an ASYMMETRICAL short fighter jacket with one dominant crescent shoulder on the LEFT, the other shoulder visibly smaller, a broad diagonal closure and a curved split-leaf lower hem. No symmetrical ordinary knight plate.
Use case: style-transfer / equipment redesign.
Asset type: ONE standalone transparent production game equipment icon, gear-standard-axe-t1-armor.
Input images are positive drawing-style references: the simple sword, simple coat and actual game character. Match their soft dark outline and broad matte colour planes. Other comparison references are described at the end. Do not draw characters or UI.
Subject: a complete short coat with crescent shoulder edges and a curved split lower hem.
Family identity across all six pieces: large crescents, curved sweeping edges and split-leaf junctions.
Family palette: warm steel, muted coral copper and dark brown leather.
Series: STANDARD -- practical forged steel, wood, stitched leather and cloth; restrained brass fittings; functional compact travel equipment, smooth or sloped surfaces, obvious straps and large simple buckles; no giant gems, no decorative spikes. The three series must be visibly different in their outer contour and material construction, even in greyscale.
Stage: T1 BASIC: one uncomplicated main structural layer; modest single fitting. Keep a plain compact contour with a short/simple guard or support. Armour has a simple vest/robe body, small shoulders; helmet has a low/simple crown; boots have simple cuffs; jewellery has one small readable mount.
Style: soft warm charcoal/brown outline, chunky rounded object proportions, matte hand-drawn colour blocks, TWO or THREE large shading planes, warm restrained highlights. Keep details broad and legible. Match the new simple chibi items, not the skinny ornate old library.
Composition: front view of one complete empty garment, no person, mannequin or display stand. Centred on a square transparent canvas, full object visible, longest visible extent roughly 78–82% of canvas, generous equal safety margin. Do not enlarge T3 beyond the common size.
At 32px the equipment part must read immediately; at 48px the family, series and stage must be recognisable by structure. Each icon depicts a coherent physical wearable or weapon, not a pasted symbol.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha; ONE isolated object (a pair only for boots). No background, floor, external cast shadow, frames, labels, text, numbers, rarity tags, characters, particles, glowing discs, tiny filigree or dense shiny rendering. Do not generate a sprite sheet or collage. The output is one production PNG.
The exact PRIMARY shape described FIRST overrides generic body/helmet stage instructions and referenced silhouettes. Preserve series construction and family palette. References establish drawing style only.
normalization: Alpha-bounds crop; proportional Lanczos resize inside 208×208; centered on a transparent 256×256 canvas.
